shots.intent: Capture Demian's final, desperate exertion of physical leverage to escape the lethal traps, culminating in a pyrrhic survival and total physical collapse.
shots.subject: Demian
shots.continuity_notes: Demian is now on the safe side of the sealed exit door, collapsed on the floor.
shots.performance: Extreme physical exertion, veins bulging in his neck, letting out a guttural roar as he forces the lever. Upon falling through the door, he exhibits total physical collapse, gasping desperately for air, completely broken.
shots.blocking: Demian smashes the final false mirror, revealing a heavy steel exit door. With the descending ceiling now scraping his shoulders, he wedges the steel handle of his seismic hammer into the door's emergency lever. Throwing his entire remaining body weight against the hammer, he forces the counterweight to snap. The door gives way. He falls forward through the doorway, slamming the heavy steel door shut behind him just as the ceiling crashes down on the other side. He hits the floor hard, gasping for clean air.
shots.atmosphere: Sensory overload and deafening mechanical pressure that abruptly cuts to absolute, heavy silence.

light.key: Cold harsh industrial edge light through the threshold shifting into dim floor practicals
light.mood: Sudden claustrophobic release, transition into heavy desaturated silence and exhaustion
light.practicals: Emergency bulkhead status light overhead, floor recess LEDs

look.palette: Desaturated slate grey, cold steel, pale skin tones, dim cyan accent
look.filter_grain: Subtle fine grain, optical halation clearing across perimeter

audio.dialogue: [Guttural roar of pure exertion]... [Desperate, exhausted gasping]
audio.voice_direction: Demian: A raw, animalistic roar of absolute physical limit, transitioning into wet, desperate, and completely depleted gasps for air.
audio.score_cue: Distorted, chaotic carnival music abruptly cuts out to total silence.
audio.sfx: Metal grinding against metal as the hammer wedges the lever, a sharp, heavy mechanical snap of the counterweight, deafening slam of a thick steel door locking shut, followed by the muffled, catastrophic crash of the ceiling collapsing on the other side. A heavy body hitting the floor.
audio.ambience: Absolute, heavy silence falling instantly as the steel door seals, isolating the space.
